media.title: Henri Varna — portrait plate from the recueil “Féerie de Paris”, 1937
media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of Henri Varna in a suit and patterned tie, head turned towards the viewer.
media.publicCaption: Henri Varna, captioned on the plate as director of the Casino de Paris and the Alcazar de Paris. From a Bibliothèque nationale de France album of press cuttings and programmes for his revue “Féerie de Paris”, covering the performance of 20 December 1937. Varna wrote the French words for four Jurmann–Kaper songs in the 1934 Casino de Paris revue Parade de France.
media.publicCreditLine: Photograph credited on the print to R. Sobol. Bibliothèque nationale de France, département des Arts du spectacle, 8-RSUPP-120, via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in France under the PD-France tag applied to the digitised recueil on Wikimedia Commons. The plate credits the photographer as “Ph. R. Sobol”; because French moral rights survive the expiry of economic rights, that attribution remains necessary.
